points.description: Method: Correct phasor/impedance modeling (Z_R=R, Z_C=1/jωC, Z_L=jωL) and conversion of sine source to cosine-reference phasor.

levels.says: One conceptual error in impedance or phasor conversion.
Two conceptual errors in impedance or phasor conversion.

points.description: Equation: Correct base equations and consistent phasor notation.

levels.says: One error in base equations or inconsistent notation.

points.description: Calculation: Correct numerical evaluation of Z_R, Z_C, Z_L1, Z_L2, and Vs at ω = 5 rad/s.
Units: Correct units (Ω, V) and consistent angle units.
Completeness: All five required quantities (Z_R, Z_C, Z_L1, Z_L2, Vs) provided with numerical values.

levels.says: Missing one required quantity or only provides formulas.
Missing two required quantities or response is vague.

rubric.notes: Students start with 100 marks. Deductions are applied for errors in method, equations, calculations, units, and completeness as specified in the rubric. Full marks are awarded for a complete, accurate set of values and expressions.
